description:
LIVE WRONG ANSWER at base (all three paths): the 8-line Pipeline.run
repro prints 12/12 for 12/90; with captures, interp self-corrects while
native ABORTS in fz_unbox_int (capture-lane ABI mismatch). Mechanism
(verified end-to-end, 2026-09-01): a forwarding hop generalizes the
arrow so one shared body serves both lambdas; the body's dispatch has
NO question that separates closure literals (runtime_type_test_envelope
flattens descr.funcs to fun_top BY POLICY); first arm takes everything;
arm 0's grounded direct call runs ITS literal against the sibling's
values. #[ignore]d red gate in tree
(compiler2_forwarded_closures_are_not_replaced_by_their_sibling).

CURE DIRECTION SETTLED BY COLD REVIEW (2026-09-01, prototype-refereed;
artifacts in session scratchpad rev125/):

GENERALIZE-AT-MINTING (my proposal) REFUTED -- DO NOT RE-PROPOSE: the
prototype at coalesce_call_emissions fixed every behavioural witness
(repro, captures, 3-lambda, tag-split; census 13->0) then broke 7
corpus fixtures (exit 0->1) and 16 lib gates incl. 2 determinism pins
and 3 anti-unioning invariants written to forbid exactly this move.
Architectural cause, both horns reproduced: the generalized key is
computable only AFTER the walk, but the walk already resolved against
the precise keys -- withdraw the precise contributions and their
activations orphan (resume-payload panic); keep them and the caller's
grounded transport disagrees with the callee's boxed ABI (expected
function 181 got 68 / expected 1 lane got 0). Also the proposal's
monotonicity premise was FALSE: the dominant fanout is a control-flow
join inside ONE row (rows=1 on opaque_fn_value_join), not row
accumulation.

BUILD: DESIGN I -- the closure-identity predicate axis. The runtime
representation already carries identity on all three paths: heap word
at +8 = code pointer (runtime/src/any_value.rs:785 closure_fn_ptr,
accessor fz_closure_code_ref at ir_runtime.rs:653); native fn_addr has
exactly ONE callable boundary per FnId (identity_fn,
native_codegen/prim.rs:2231/surface.rs:77); interp slot literally
holds the FnId (ir_interp/backend.rs:2803, unpack_closure binop.rs:71).
The interp ALREADY runs an identity check in production
(direct_callable_capture_lanes, backend.rs:2660-2698 -- errors on
wrong fn id and unpacks boxed captures). Census: 13/13 corpus
no-question groups separable BY FN ID ALONE.

SPEC (reviewer-written, follow exactly):
1. RuntimeTypePredicate.closures: bool -> callables:
   FiniteSet<ClosureTarget> (the shape atoms already has);
   overlaps/any/none mechanically.
2. runtime_type_test_envelope (types/mod.rs:1519) stops flattening
   descr.funcs to fun_top: keep literal FN IDS, erase args/ret/captures
   -- the one-line policy inversion; discriminating_inputs then finds
   the callable column and pattern_dispatch_from_source emits the test
   unaided.
3. Interp test: matches_runtime_type_predicate via existing
   unpack_closure / AnyValue::FnRef arms.
4. Native/AOT: new Region::Type lowering in native_codegen/
   type_pred.rs: load(closure_ptr+8) vs fn_addr(callable_boundary_for_
   identity(fn)); MakeFnRef singletons carry the same address
   (fetch_static_closure) -- one comparison covers both shapes.
5. ABI at identity-tested arms: STAGE-MEASURE FIRST the simple shape --
   keep the callable a ValueRef input at multi-destination callsites
   and let the callee project captures in its entry harness
   (closure_capture_as_binding, native_codegen/entry.rs:140 already
   does this); only build caller-side unpack (closure_capture_*_at
   primitives) if measurement demands it.
6. BACKSTOP: where the axis cannot separate (fz-kdt.127's same-fn-id
   shape), emit the unrepresentable-plan diagnostic instead of
   order-decided routing (corpus fallout measured ZERO).
7. Gates: un-ignore the forwarded-closures gate; q2join (fz-kdt.126)
   + captures variant as three-path gates; extend the shadow-free gate
   to the census 9 fixtures; keep FZ_STRESS_REVERSE_DISPATCH_ARMS
   (stronger once arms are real); N3's arm-ABI assert (fz-kdt.128).
8. DELETIONS RIDE ALONG: closures:bool; the fun_top flatten line + its
   policy comment; 'callable correlation is runtime-unobservable'
   claims in callsite_dispatch.rs:146 and kdt.123's body; fold
   question_groups helper (kdt.107 F5 -- reviewer built it, ~35->~6
   lines).
CLASSIFICATION EXPECTATION: zero key/demand/transport/inventory
movement; canon movement confined to dispatch plans gaining tests on 9
fixtures; anything else STOP.
